column1: # kit_life-migrations.retired.tsv -- retirement declaration (DGN-1519)
# Consumed by routines/retire-prune.py. Format: 5 TAB-separated columns:
#   path <TAB> sha256[,sha256...] <TAB> ticket <TAB> declared-date <TAB> reason
# A file is pruned ONLY when its bytes match one of the pinned hashes
# (fail-closed: any other content is reported DIVERGED and left in place).
# Declarer checklist (all four hold for every line below, DGN-1519 design s.3):
#   1. replacement delivered first: the canonical migration set (kit_life pack
#      payload, 012..050, renumbered/rewritten) is already installed on the
#      affected instances; these files are the PRE-rename leftovers.
#   2. callers searched beyond ast: the migration runner selects files by
#      canonical numbering; nothing invokes these paths by name from shell/
#      plist/cron (they are data files, not executables).
#   3. reversible order: retire-prune.py moves to files/_archive/retired-<ts>/
#      (never rm); one --undo restores everything.
#   4. hashes pinned by measurement (2026-09-17): current bytes on the two
#      affected live instances (byte-identical across them where both hold a
#      file), plus the pre-2026-08-28 delivery bytes for the three files the
#      fleet-wide lifekit->kit_life rename sweep mutated in place (instance
#      continuity history is the evidence chain -- every touch was a
#      framework act, no user edits; full derivation: DGN-1519 design doc).
# Why retired: the canonical migration baseline was renumbered at the lifekit
# extraction (product repo 94e3afd7); 007..010 were folded into the baseline,
# 011..014 were renamed one number up (011_soge_profile -> 012_soge_profile,
# 012_persons_gender -> 013_persons_gender, 013_persons_relations ->
# 014_persons_relations, 014_relation_type_unify -> 015_relation_type_unify).
# update/pack sync has no --delete, so the pre-rename copies stayed and the
# stale numbers collide with their successors (reddens 4 kit tests; the
# runner's own numbering defect is DGN-1522, out of scope here).
# Deliberately NOT declared (DGN-1519 design s.3/s.4): instance-local helper
# scripts living in the same directory (health_to_warg.py, notion_to_sqlite.py,
# warg_to_ag.py, areas_domain_remap_7d.py, notion_projects_resync.py) and
# routines/lib/handoff/handoff_cli.py (send-lane instances still execute it;
# its retirement is blocked on DGN-1061/DGN-1379).
